name: Chipoltergeist
tagline: THE BUILDING IS HAUNTED. THE LINE MOVES ANYWAY.
address: 8814 Outparcel Loop, Bay 3, Sunhaven Commons Power Center, Exit 219B
about: Chipoltergeist assembles wrapped cylinders and open vessels in full view of the guest, using constituents sourced from suppliers who have signed something. The premises are haunted; this disclosure satisfies all applicable notice requirements and no further action is available. Staff will not make eye contact, which is a service standard and not a mood.
announcement: PARANORMAL DISCLOSURE POSTED. Cold spots between the salsa well and the register are known, documented, and priced into the menu. Service continues.

reviews.name: Deshaun P.
reviews.text: Ordered the Municipal Cylinder and it arrived on a dolly. The Slinger did not speak and I respected that.

reviews.name: Marguerite V.
reviews.text: I declined the tortilla and was charged for the tortilla. The note explained why, so I have no complaint.

reviews.name: Toby L.
reviews.text: The whispering in the bag was faint and did not affect the food. Guacamole license expired before I got home.

reviews.name: Renata K.
reviews.text: Vessel arrived overfilled past the rim as advertised. My car is also overfilled past the rim now.

reviews.name: Alonzo B.
reviews.text: I selected Enforced Silence and my entire household was quiet for eleven minutes. Worth $5.15.

reviews.name: Priya S.
reviews.text: Cold-Pressed Residue tastes exactly like the name. The sediment disclosure card was informative.

menu.name: Wrapped Cylinders
menu.blurb: Assembled in front of you. Commentary is not included.

items.name: The Standard Cylinder
items.desc: Our foundational wrapped cylinder, compressed to specification and sealed in foil. Mass is guaranteed; contents are directional.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: one enormous foil-wrapped burrito the diameter of a fence post, foil peeled back in a spiral to expose a packed cylinder of rice, black beans, charred meat and melted cheese under visible internal pressure, the tortilla stretched thin and shining at the seams, a slow bead of orange fat running down the side, steam rising in a thin column. Placed on a brushed matte-black steel serving counter with kraft paper and raw reclaimed wood, faint pale vapor curling upward in the background. Lighting: single warm tungsten spotlight from directly above, deep shadows, artisanal minimalism, a faint cold blue haze in the shadows. Camera: 85mm lens at three-quarter hero angle, shallow depth of field, high micro-contrast, deep blacks. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

menu.name: Open Vessels

items.name: The Vessel
items.desc: Our signature open-format bowl, filled past the rim by policy. The rim is a suggestion the kitchen has declined.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a deep matte-black bowl shot straight down into, filled far past its rim with cilantro-flecked rice, glossy black beans, charred red peppers, shredded meat and a pale mound of guacamole, the contents domed above the rim and sagging over one edge onto the counter, a thin salsa slick pooling beneath, faint steam curling off the surface. Set on a brushed matte-black steel serving counter with kraft paper and raw reclaimed wood, faint pale vapor curling upward in the background. Lighting: single warm tungsten spotlight from directly above, deep shadows, artisanal minimalism, a faint cold blue haze in the shadows. Camera: 50mm directly overhead, tight top-down framing, moderate depth of field, rich shadow detail. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a restaurant employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a heaped serving of thick-cut fried corn tortilla chips spilling out of a torn brown paper sleeve that has been folded open and laid on its side, chips piled high and dusted with coarse salt and fried corn crumbs, a small clear plastic cup of red salsa sitting beside the sleeve with a lid resting next to it, this is a fast-casual burrito counter kitchen. Flat overhead fluorescent tube light with a green-yellow colour cast and no fill, mixed white balance. Cluttered background: a stainless prep counter, a napkin dispenser, a stack of lids and another order waiting in a foil-wrapped bundle.
